topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The sun feels different today, not as warm as it used to. My neighbor came by, asking if he could use a corner of my yard for a garden. It’s a small space, really, a patch of earth he thinks could use some life. I see the enthusiasm in his eyes, the hopeful smile that doesn’t quite reach the edges. I say yes, of course, trying to sound as cheerful as I feel inside. As he thanks me, I notice how the leaves rustle gently, as though whispering a quiet, lonely secret. I watch him leave, a lighter step in his walk, and I close the gate, the old hinges creaking softly, like an old, forgotten friend.
